title: 19-BCV-021 - Off-site review of buildings

facts.text: The variance applies to off-site-constructed buildings except relocatable industrial camp buildings.
It lists three alternative methods: CSA A660 certification for completed steel modules, verification by registered architectural/engineering professionals, or AHJ off-site inspections.

The source requires sealed/stamped drawings, specifications, and a conformance letter for the professional-verification method; if local off-site inspection is infeasible, certain on-site inspections may be agreed during plan examination.

An additional letter of assurance by a registered professional or AHJ permit-service report is required for installation of building services such as electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and building envelope.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
